info.title: YNAB Universal API
info.description: Manage budgets, accounts, categories, and transactions

get.description: Retrieves an account from a YNAB plan.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

balance.description: The current account balance in milliunits.

balanceFormatted.description: The current account balance formatted for display.

deleted.description: Whether the account has been deleted.

onBudget.description: Whether the account is on budget.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

goalUnderFunded.description: The underfunded amount in milliunits, when present.
